description:
READ-ONLY on the data: pull a live Odoo database's BUSINESS DATA out into one
    open-format JSON file (`out_file`), so it can be loaded into a database created
    FROM SCRATCH - the alternative to `migrate_transfer`+`restore_to_prod`, which copy
    the database itself (same uuid, same history, same expiry, same technical debt).

    Use this path when the target must be a NEW database: changing Odoo major version,
    leaving a bloated database behind, splitting one database into several, or when the
    source may not be copied. References are written three ways (external id, natural
    key, source id) so they can be re-resolved in a database whose ids differ.

    NOT included: chatter history, accounting entries, unrelated attachments, passwords -
    the result says so explicitly. If the client needs those, use the copy path.

    `scope` narrows what leaves the box (it is echoed back in the result, so what was left
    out on purpose is visible): {"<model>": [extra domain], "res.users": [domain],
    "_skip_models": [...], "_skip_params": [key prefixes]} - e.g. only the paid-course
    product instead of 33 products an app install created, only internal users, no test
    drafts, and no secrets of a module the new database will not have.
name: data_extract
